content: Have you ever heard a machine that shows you what you want to see? Welcome to the world—the one who harness engineering via software. Imagine the things you do manually can be automated and optimized. That is software, and software can do many things in your life like seeing a visually captivating visuals and maybe a button that cooks your food while you are away. This is just the tip of software engineering and I, as one of the fellow, to contribute to the growing world of technology.
